marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major semiconductor vendors reported resilient enterprise server hardware demand driven by hyperscaler AI cluster expansion, alongside upward revisions to annual CapEx guidance.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained cloud infrastructure spending provides mid-term revenue visibility across the hardware supply chain, offsetting weakness in legacy PC and consumer electronics segments.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Geopolitical trade policy shifts and potential tightening of export control parameters on advanced computing hardware.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Digital Economy
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index stabilized as leading internet conglomerates announced expanded share buyback programs alongside regulatory clarity on cross-border data compliance.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive capital return measures (buybacks and dividends) are providing a valuation floor for HK big tech, mitigating broader macroeconomic headwinds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Intensifying price competition in cloud services and domestic e-commerce live-streaming segments.

marketLayer.title: US Macro & Monetary Policy Outlook
marketLayer.fact: Latest labor market and inflation indicators aligned with consensus forecasts, solidifying market expectations for a rate easing cycle later in the year.
marketLayer.inference: A controlled disinflation trajectory maintains liquidity support for growth equities and limits upside pressure on long-duration Treasury yields.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential re-acceleration of service sector inflation or unexpected labor market tightness.

marketLayer.title: HK & Mainland Electric Vehicles
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV makers posted strong delivery numbers for the current month while accelerating export expansion into Southeast Asia and Latin America.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas sales expansion serves as a critical growth driver to absorb domestic capacity and support blended gross margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving foreign trade barriers, import tariffs, and local subsidy policy changes in target export destinations.
